prompt: I kicked off an EAS build like 20 minutes ago and I don't remember the URL. How do I check if it's done? Also once it finishes I want to know my options for getting it to testers without using the terminal.

assertions.text: Runs or recommends `eas build:list` to find the build and its status
Mentions the Expo web dashboard as an alternative to check build status
Provides the Expo dashboard URL pattern or tells user to go to expo.dev
Explains at least 2 non-CLI options for submitting to TestFlight
Does NOT default to CLI commands for the submission part since user asked for non-terminal options
